confirmedP1.trigger: Ready model, registered ready executor/workspace and otherwise valid fresh kickoff with duplicate criteria, including duplicates made equal by trim.
sourceCausality: Kickoff inputSchema accepts duplicates while supervisorCreateSchema requires new Set(criteria).size === criteria.length.
Kickoff writes prepared and creates the task before supervisor.create parses its stricter schema.

The rejected session creation leaves the original incomplete intent and task ownership. Same-command changed criteria conflicts with the frozen fingerprint; a new command is rejected as KICKOFF_PENDING; replay of the frozen input fails the same schema.
confirmedP1.impact: A user input error creates durable pending ownership from which the exposed normal kickoff flow cannot recover by correcting the input. This is the already identified prevalidation P1, not a new untested-matrix finding.
confirmedP1.minimalFix: Reuse the exported original pure supervisorCreateSchema for the exact generated create payload before the first durable intent/task side effect, preserving the uniqueness rule and every original guard. Do not remove uniqueness or rewrite prior intent/task history.
confirmedP1.minimalEvidence: One targeted real-route duplicate/trim-duplicate counterexample that demonstrates the current side effect, then verifies rejection leaves zero kickoff/task/session/run effects and corrected valid input can explicitly start. Preserve the existing 6/6 evidence; do not rerun unrelated UI/full matrices.

closedOriginalFindings.evidence: Recovery always replays the fixed original supervisor.create command receipt and freezes that original revision. Before start it compares the current session binding, draft status and original revision; owner control changes reject CONTROL_CHANGED without dispatch. The hook is after actual session commit and before coordinator intent update; restart is exercised.

pureSchemaComparison.taskCreateSubset: Generated title <=200 versus max300; goal <=4000 versus max20000; joined criteria <=15029 versus max20000; budget 1 and retryLimit 0 fit original task DTO. This is not an additional pure-field failure.
pureSchemaComparison.knownStateGuardBoundary: Original taskBody also rejects delivered projects, company scope and observation-only machines (work-domains.ts:64-75,127-130), while workbench preflight directly checks archived/model/choice/revision. These are existing downstream state restrictions, not a second supervisorCreateSchema difference; no live affected record was inspected and no separate present-user blocker is asserted. Preserve these restrictions; do not relax them to make kickoff pass.

preservedSemantics.pendingContext: Owner/project-scoped context exposes original command/input/fingerprint/stage/task/session/startRevision. Recovery uses exact frozen input and fixed stage command IDs, and does not adopt a new project revision or silently replace an old request.
preservedSemantics.ownership: Incomplete intents retain pending task ownership; existing execution start/preflight/scheduler ownership guards remain. The original task-before-session saved test exercises refusal of scheduler/normal-start theft.
preservedSemantics.pausedAndUnknown: Old paused/blocked tasks are not implicitly resumed by the new flow. Existing policies, unknown/incomplete accounting and signed-result reconciliation remain; no reset or synthetic complete ledger is introduced.
preservedSemantics.budget: Task DTO budget:1 is a compatibility value; supervisor dispatch explicitly uses record-only and budgetUSD0, and the agent record-only path skips the currency cap. It is not a new one-dollar cap.
preservedSemantics.executorLabel: Session executor literal claude-code is existing session metadata. The actual configured task executor/template engine remains bound for dispatch; the context codex choice alone is not proven to fail solely because of that label.
